description: Covers every dependency on trunk: npm/pnpm (all workspace packages, packageManager, lockfile), GitHub Actions, and the Maven and NuGet projects in tests/code-export. Only one Renovate branch and PR at a time.

packageRules.description: Keep electron and electron-chromedriver on the same version, in their own PR.
Group GitHub Actions updates, majors included.
C# NUnit exports use Assert.True, which NUnit 4 removed.
Node.js types follow the oldest supported Node.js major (22).
